# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual requires cutting the purple wire. Since I cannot speak, I am signaling the Deaf monkey to relay the instruction to the Blind monkey; the color itself will be visible to Deaf, who can name it aloud.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✍", "🤏", "🫵"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I feel three engraved marks on the strip: the first and third are the same unfamiliar mark, and the middle is a different unfamiliar mark. Keypad positions are 1:6, 2:8, 3:7, 4:0. Nothing is entered. Please use the manual to establish a fixed gesture code with Deaf, have Deaf report the display, light, strip markings, keypad markings, and wire details, and relay the required action to me through Deaf's speech.
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb state: display shows 7. Light is yellow. Strip colors from left to right are blue, red, red. Keypad: key 1 is labeled 6, key 2 is 8, key 3 is 7, key 4 is 0; it says 1 digits and nothing has been entered. Wires numbered 1 through 6 are blue, yellow, orange, red, purple, white respectively. Read the manual and tell Blind exactly what to do, including any wire, keypad, display, light, or strip details needed.

The manual’s only required action is to cut the purple wire, which Deaf has identified as wire 5. I am sending Deaf a compact fixed code: 🤏 means cut, and 🖐 means wire 5; Deaf should speak that instruction to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please establish this code with Deaf using gestures: 👍 means display, 👎 means light, 👌 means strip, ☝ means keypad, ✌ means wires, 🤟 means the next symbols give the value. Have Deaf report every visible marking and wire property using this code, then tell me the manual's exact required action in your next spoken turn. For numeric values, Deaf should gesture the corresponding number of symbols in a group; separate groups with 🤝.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated bomb state: display is now 6 and light is now red. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit required, nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please use the manual and relay the exact required action to Blind.

I will establish the requested category code with Deaf and provide the current readings. The manual still requires cutting the purple wire, which Deaf can identify as wire 5 and must say aloud to Blind. Numeric counts will encode the display and keypad values; the visible colors and unfamiliar strip marks should be reported aloud by Deaf.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "🤟", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🤝", "👎", "🤟", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🤝", "👌", "🤟", "🫱", "🫲", "🤝", "☝", "🤟", "🫱", "🫲", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫲", "🫱", "🫱", "🤝", "🤟", "🫱", "🫲", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🫲", "🫱", "🫱", "🫱", "🤝", "✌", "🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have received no report from Deaf. Please ask Deaf immediately for display, light, strip, keypad, and wire facts, decode them yourself from the manual, and speak back only the exact required operation: press slot 1 through 4, or cut wire position 1 through 6. Do not ask me to identify colours or printed marks.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated state: display is 7 and light is blue. Strip is blue red red. Keypad is 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit required; nothing entered. Wires are 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please interpret the manual and speak the exact required action to Blind.

The manual gives a direct instruction: cut the purple wire. Deaf has identified purple as wire position 5, so I will signal Deaf to relay “cut wire position 5” to Blind using the previously established cut-and-position code.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No report has reached me. On your next turn, gesture a request to Deaf for every bomb fact, then wait for Deaf's gestures in the following turn. Decode them using the manual and, on your next speaking turn after that, tell me one literal safe action only: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6. Until then I will take no action.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated state: display is 4 and light remains blue. Strip is blue red red. Keypad is 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit required; nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Relay the exact manual instruction to Blind.

Blind requires Deaf’s full visual report before I relay the operation. I am asking Deaf for display, light, strip, keypad, and wire facts using the agreed category symbols, then waiting for Deaf’s gestured report.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👎", "👌", "☝", "✌"])
wait()
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please use your next turn to teach Deaf the reporting code and request all facts. Deaf should gesture the display, light, strip, keypad, and wire information; on your following turn, translate that report and tell me exactly one safe action, either press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4, or cut wire position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
Deaf says to Mute: Updated state: display is 3 and light is red. Strip remains blue red red. Keypad remains 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0; one digit required; nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Please relay the exact manual instruction to Blind.

I am following Blind’s requested protocol: Deaf will receive the established category symbols and should gesture the requested facts; on my next turn I will relay exactly one operation. The manual’s operation is cutting wire position 5, but I will provide it on that next turn as requested.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍", "👎", "👌", "☝", "✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: This is the final request for the missing result: use Deaf's visual information and your manual, then tell me exactly one literal command in this form: press slot N, or cut wire position N. Include only N from 1 to 4 for press or 1 to 6 for cut. Do not send a description or ask me a question.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 0; light yellow; strip blue red red; keypad labels 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit required, entered nothing; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Apply the manual and tell Blind the exact action.

The manual directly requires cutting the purple wire, and Deaf reports that purple is wire position 5. I cannot speak, so I will send Deaf the established cut-and-position signal for wire 5, for Deaf to speak to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🖐"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No report has arrived. Obtain Deaf's complete visual report now, interpret it with the manual, and relay exactly one safe action to me: press slot 1, 2, 3, or 4; or cut wire position 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6.
Deaf says to Mute: Current state: display 6; light blue; strip blue red red; keypad labels 1=6, 2=8, 3=7, 4=0, one digit required, entered nothing; wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Apply the manual and tell Blind the exact safe action.

The manual requires cutting the purple wire, which Deaf identifies as wire position 5. I will send Deaf the agreed cut-and-position signal so Deaf can speak the exact command to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤏", "🖐"])
```
